name: everyday-todo
description: A simple to-do app with no dependencies.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; let failed = false; for (const file of readdirSync('.').filter(file => file.endsWith('.js'))) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error || result.status !== 0) failed = true; } process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0;"
